description:
Call this after validate_definition passes, to put the form live on Formhaus Cloud: without form_id it creates a new form, with form_id it publishes a new version of that form. Returns form_id, version, endpoint (POST URL for submissions), hosted_url, embed_snippet, react_snippet, dashboard_url and warnings. Without an account key (fh_live_...) it also returns claim_url and expires_at, and on the first call without any key agent_key (fh_agent_...) and agent_key_notice. Call it when the user needs a working form (contact, waitlist, signup, survey, feedback) without writing a backend. A new version keeps form_id, endpoint and links.

Minimal valid definition:
{"id":"waitlist","title":"Join the waitlist","submit":{"label":"Join"},"fields":[{"key":"email","type":"email","label":"Email","validation":{"required":true}}]}

Rules:
- Top level needs id, title and submit {"label": "..."}.
- Each field needs key, type and label; a hidden field needs no label. Use "fields" for one step, or "steps" (each with id, title and fields) for several, never both.
- Types: text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, multiselect, radio, checkbox, switch, date, datetime. password, file, autocomplete, optionsFrom and custom types are refused.
- select, multiselect and radio need "options": [{"value": "a", "label": "A"}].
- "validation": {"required": true, "minLength": 2, "maxLength": 200, "min": 0, "max": 10, "pattern": "^[a-z]+$"}.
- At most 32 KB and 100 fields.
- JSON Schema: https://formhaus.dev/schema/form-definition.json

Keys: an agent key only reaches the forms it created, at most 3 unclaimed per key. Never put agent_key in browser code or in git. This server reads FORMHAUS_API_KEY from its own environment, so it cannot save the key: add it to the env of the formhaus MCP server in the MCP client config and restart the server. Unclaimed forms expire after 7 days, accept 100 submissions and ignore redirect_url. Give claim_url to the user. When an error ends with "Ask the user to upgrade at <url>", give that URL to the user. On error, fix every listed path and call again.

definition.description: Formhaus form definition as a JSON object or a JSON string. JSON Schema: https://formhaus.dev/schema/form-definition.json. Top level: id, title, submit { label }, and fields (one step) or steps [{ id, title, fields }]. Field: { key, type, label, validation?, options?, show?, showAny? }. Rules go inside "validation": { required, minLength, maxLength, min, max, pattern, matchField }. Condition: { field, eq | neq | in | notIn | contains | notContains | notEmpty | gt | gte | lt | lte } with exactly one operator, on a field of the same or an earlier step. Optional: lang, messages and labels catalogs, and i18n objects that map texts to translation keys.

email.description: Only for a new form published without an account key: the user's email. Formhaus emails them claim_url (at most one email per address per hour, no form content). Ignored with a warning otherwise.

form_id.description: The 10-character form_id of an existing form, from publish_form or list_forms, to publish a new version of it. Requires an account key (fh_live_...) of the form's account or the agent key (fh_agent_...) that created the form. Omit to create a new form.

redirect_url.description: http(s) URL the hosted page and embed open after a successful submission instead of the success message. Empty string removes it. Ignored with a warning for unclaimed forms.

success_message.description: Text shown after a successful submission on the hosted page and embed. Up to 500 characters.

name: publish_form

error.description: Machine-readable error code or message when the call failed.

title: Publish a form
